topic: Data analysis and sensor model review
summary_markdown:
The discussion covered two main areas: the technical status of a sensor model for Estonia, and an upcoming correlation analysis.

Regarding the sensor model, it was noted that the current setup (using two sensors) is functional, but further points are needed to demonstrate proper Wi-Fi performance. The team confirmed issues with tracking two lanes. If demonstrating Wi-Fi capability is not required, the existing two-sensor model can be maintained.

Separately, a correlation analysis was requested by someone and will be sent to her and Rasmus for a demonstration once completed.
decisions: The two-sensor model can be retained if Wi-Fi performance demonstration is unnecessary.
action_items: Complete the correlation analysis and send it to the specified recipients for a demo.
